_comment: The manifest of @abap2ui5/runtime. It lives HERE and NOT at node/package.json:
a package.json inside node/ makes that directory an npm package root, and
`npm run <script>` from there stops walking up to this repository's own
scripts. `cd node && npm run express` then answers `Missing script: express`,
which is exactly what node/playwright.config.js starts its web server with -
so all four browser projects failed to boot (#2772, found by CI).
backend-prebuilt.yaml copies this file to package.json in a STAGING directory
outside the checkout, assembles the three trees beside it, and packs there.
name: @abap2ui5/runtime
description: abap2UI5 transpiled to JavaScript by @abaplint/transpiler over open-abap: the framework (output/), the setup hook it imports (setup/) and the UI5 shell (webapp/) from one release commit. Published by release.yaml; the version is the framework's.
